Design-aware multivariate dispersion inference

Source: R/dispersion.R
permanova_dispersion.Rd

Converts the original dissimilarity to distances from each observation to its target-group spatial median or centroid, then tests that scalar response with the EMS denominator and restricted residual permutation appropriate to a validated balanced design. The initial envelope contains exactly one categorical fixed main effect.

Usage

permanova_dispersion(
  formula = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  distance = NULL,
  term = NULL,
  type = c("median", "centroid"),
  bias_adjust = FALSE,
  permutations = 999L,
  seed = NULL,
  keep_permutations = FALSE,
  max_exact = 100000L,
  tol = 1e-10,
  design = NULL
)

Arguments

formula

A model formula, or a compiled permanova_design object. The dissimilarity may be supplied on the left-hand side, for example bray ~ treatment + (1 | site), or through distance with a one-sided formula. A compiled design remains accepted for low-level workflows.

data

A data frame with one row per observation. Do not supply it when formula is already a compiled design. For backward compatibility, the second positional argument after a compiled design may be the target term name.

distance

A dist object or full distance matrix, used with a one-sided formula.

term

Optional name of the sole categorical fixed main-effect term. It is inferred when the model contains exactly one fixed term.

type

Group spatial "median" or "centroid".

bias_adjust

Apply the small-sample group-size adjustment.

permutations

A non-negative integer or "all".

seed

Optional permutation seed.

keep_permutations

Retain permutation statistics.

max_exact

Maximum exact permutation space.

tol

Numerical tolerance.

design

Backward-compatible named alias for a compiled Design Object; use formula = design or pass the object as the first argument.

Value

An object of class permanova_dispersion.

Examples

data(dune, dune.env, package = "vegan")
selected <- dune.env$Management %in% c("NM", "SF")
env <- droplevels(dune.env[selected, , drop = FALSE])
bray <- vegan::vegdist(dune[selected, ], method = "bray")
permanova_dispersion(
  bray ~ Management, env, permutations = 19, seed = 1
)
#> Design-aware multivariate dispersion test
#> Term: Management  Center: median 
#> Engine: one-way 
#> Permutation: full-model residual permutation of observations 
#>        term df         ss         ms  pseudo_f p_perm
#>  Management  1 0.02578244 0.02578244 0.9172607   0.25
#>    Residual 10 0.28108080 0.02810808        NA     NA
